the presence of vacancy defects in the graphene sheet and SWCNTs can reduce their ultimate strength by up to 10% and 3% respectively.
the presence of a single vacancy defect in graphene and SWCNT reduces ultimate tensile strength, strain to failure, elastic modulus and yield strength.
a vacancy defect in a CNT is more stable than a graphene sheet and the ultimate tensile strength of CNT is less affected by vacancy defect compared to a graphene sheet.

the effect of a single defect on the strength of CNT and Graphene sheet, and the effect of strain measures on the stress-strained relationship of CNT and graphenes sheet.
the effect of a vacancy defect on mechanical properties of graphene sheet and SWCNT.
the effects of the vacancy defect in graphene sheet and CNT on their ultimate strength and strain.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presence of a vacancy defect in a graphene sheet and CNTs reduces the strength, and the effect is more prominent in a graphene sheet.
the presence of vacancy defects in graphene sheets and carbon nanotube has a negligible effect on their strength.
the vacancy defect reduces the strength of a SWCNT and graphene sheet.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the presence of a defect in a graphene sheet or CNT reduces their strength.
the presence of vacancy defects in graphene sheet and CNT reduces their strength, and the effect is more significant for graphene sheet than CNT.
a vacancy defect in a graphene sheet is not as detrimental to the ultimate strength and strain of the sheet as it is to the strength and strain of a SWCNT.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in order to accurately capture the effect of a defect on the mechanical properties of a material, one must use the true strain as the strain metric.
the effect of vacancy defects on the strength of CNTs is not significant.
the engineering strain is more suitable for CNTs, whereas the true strain is more suitable to describe the stress-strain relationship for graphene sheet.
